desc: Smith & Wesson is excited to introduce the all new Volunteer Series rifles! Built on greatness! These new rifles are chambered in 5.56 NATO and configured for a wide variety of recreational, sport shooting and professional applications! They offer premium stocks, grips, handguards, triggers, sights, upgraded 5R rifling and ambidextrous features. The S&W Volunteer Series rifles are purpose built and are everything you'll need right out of the box! Proven. Trusted. Improved. The Smith & Wesson Volunteer XV Series.
